Transform your space with the Jeminise sports bedding set, offering a cozy and stylish design perfect for football fans, players, and coaches. research_snapshot.body_html:
Transform your space into the ultimate sports-themed sanctuary with the custom football comforter set by Jeminise. Featuring a vintage-inspired graphic illustration design of an American football close up on the American flag with stars and stripes, this bedding offers a super soft feel and a layer of breathable warmth. Perfect for football players, fans, and coaches, this custom bedding set brings the spirit of the game directly to your bedroom decor.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your own text inputs such as name or number for a truly unique sports bedding piece.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Vibrant & Durable: Features an advanced environmental protection dyeing technique that ensures colors hold and prevent fading over time.
  • Available Options: Choose between a lightweight duvet cover designed for inserts or a thicker, cozy comforter for all-season warmth.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, tumble dry on low heat, or air dry to keep the fabric fluffy and soft.

Product Specifications

Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Retro Football Art
Theme Football
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat

product_js.description:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with this custom-designed comforter set from Jeminise. This sporty bedding features a high-quality graphic of a football engulfed in flames and lightning, making it an excellent gift for football players, coaches, and passionate fans who want to bring the excitement of the game into their home decor.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with options for text inputs, such as entering a custom name and number to make it uniquely yours.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a lightweight, soft, and durable sleeping experience.
  • Cozy Comforter Option: Features a whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping and shifting, providing breathable warmth for all seasons.
  • Duvet Cover Option: A lightweight option designed with a hidden zipper closure, making it easy to insert, remove, and wash.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Optional Pillowcases: Complete your sports-themed bed set with matching optional pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, quick to dry, and engineered to hold dye and prevent fading.

Fabric Type Polyester

research_snapshot.body_html:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with this custom-designed comforter set from Jeminise. This sporty bedding features a high-quality graphic of a football engulfed in flames and lightning, making it an excellent gift for football players, coaches, and passionate fans who want to bring the excitement of the game into their home decor.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with options for text inputs, such as entering a custom name and number to make it uniquely yours.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a lightweight, soft, and durable sleeping experience.
  • Cozy Comforter Option: Features a whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping and shifting, providing breathable warmth for all seasons.
  • Duvet Cover Option: A lightweight option designed with a hidden zipper closure, making it easy to insert, remove, and wash.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Optional Pillowcases: Complete your sports-themed bed set with matching optional pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, quick to dry, and engineered to hold dye and prevent fading.

research_snapshot.body_html:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with the custom footballer comforter set from Jeminise. This soft and lightweight bedding is designed for football lovers, players, and fans, featuring a striking graphic illustration of a football player holding a ball. Perfectly combining style and athletic passion, it adds a vibrant, energetic touch to any kids' room, teen bedroom, or guestroom decor.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with two text inputs, allowing you to add your preferred name and number for a truly unique sports-themed look.
  • Comfort & Warmth: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping or shifting, providing a super soft and cozy feel in all seasons.
  • Available Sizes: Available in multiple sizes to suit any bed, including Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88").
  • Included Components: Each set package includes one high-quality comforter (or duvet cover) and optional matching pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Durable and quick-drying fabric is machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry on low heat to keep it fluffy.

Transform your space into the ultimate football sanctuary with this custom sports comforter set from Jeminise. Featuring a bold, dark photorealistic illustration of an American football player holding a football close up, this bedding is the perfect gift for football players, fans, and coaches alike. Add a personal touch with customizable name and number options to make your bedroom truly one of a kind.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with your own name (up to 25 characters) and jersey number (up to 5 characters) for a personalized team look.

  • Vibrant & Fade-Resistant: Advanced printing techniques ensure rich, lasting dye retention with neat, fine stitching along the edges for enhanced durability.
  • Flexible Options: Available as either a lightweight duvet cover with a hidden zipper closure or a cozy, all-in-one filled comforter.
  • Optional Accessories: Customize your set further by adding matching football-themed pillowcases or an additional flat sheet cover.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry low or air dry for quick, fluffy results.

research_snapshot.body_html:
Transform your space into the ultimate football sanctuary with this custom sports comforter set from Jeminise. Featuring a bold, dark photorealistic illustration of an American football player holding a football close up, this bedding is the perfect gift for football players, fans, and coaches alike. Add a personal touch with customizable name and number options to make your bedroom truly one of a kind.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize your bedding with your own name (up to 25 characters) and jersey number (up to 5 characters) for a personalized team look.
  • Comfy & Durable Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with soft, lightweight microfiber filling designed to prevent clumping and shifting.
  • Vibrant & Fade-Resistant: Advanced printing techniques ensure rich, lasting dye retention with neat, fine stitching along the edges for enhanced durability.
  • Flexible Options: Available as either a lightweight duvet cover with a hidden zipper closure or a cozy, all-in-one filled comforter.
  • Optional Accessories: Customize your set further by adding matching football-themed pillowcases or an additional flat sheet cover.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry low or air dry for quick, fluffy results.

Product Specifications

Material Microfiber Polyester
Color Dark Football Art

Style Contemporary
Customization Name and Number inputs
Available Sizes Twin, Full, Queen, King
Care Instructions Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

Bring the thrilling spirit of the game straight to your bedroom with this custom sports-themed bedding set from Jeminise. product_js.description:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with this Custom Camo Football Player Comforter from Jeminise. Perfect for football players, fans, and coaches, this high-quality bedding features a distinctive camo design of a football player running on a flag, bringing athletic energy and personal style straight to your space. Fully customizable with options to add your own name and number, it makes an exceptionally thoughtful gift for boys, teens, and sports lovers of all ages.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Supports customization options with 2 text inputs for adding a name and number of your choice.
  • Cozy & Soft Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Sporty Artwork: Features a graphic illustration of an American football player running on a camouflage flag with stars and stripes.
  • Versatile Product Options: Available as either a lightweight duvet cover (without filling) or an all-in-one thick comforter set.
  • Available Sizes: Comes in standard US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, quick drying, and designed to prevent fading.

research_snapshot.body_html:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with this Custom Camo Football Player Comforter from Jeminise. Perfect for football players, fans, and coaches, this high-quality bedding features a distinctive camo design of a football player running on a flag, bringing athletic energy and personal style straight to your space. Fully customizable with options to add your own name and number, it makes an exceptionally thoughtful gift for boys, teens, and sports lovers of all ages.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Supports customization options with 2 text inputs for adding a name and number of your choice.
  • Cozy & Soft Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Sporty Artwork: Features a graphic illustration of an American football player running on a camouflage flag with stars and stripes.
  • Versatile Product Options: Available as either a lightweight duvet cover (without filling) or an all-in-one thick comforter set.
  • Available Sizes: Comes in standard US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, quick drying, and designed to prevent fading.
